text:
maya: heads-up — after today's roll we see a 30-40% tok/sec drop on CTB pools and queueing delays spiking. rollout id: r-2026-03-18-13
ci-bot: [perf-ci] job perf/ctb-tokenrate — FAILED
ci-bot: baseline: 18.2k tok/s, current: 11.6k tok/s (-36%), p95 latency +120ms
sam: assigning to perf-sleuth. can you paste flame traces / profiler output?
maya: putting rollout on hold. @alex @rachel :eyes:
alex: noted. I merged a kernel-selector tweak in 0f4b3c9 earlier today. suspect kernel affinity change
rachel: KV metrics look weird — hitrate dropped 92% -> 68% for same demo workload
rachel: quick profiler dump from canary worker:
```
# hot paths (aggregated)
memcpy_v2 (gpu)               42.1%
kernel_select_fastpath         26.8%
coalesce_loop                 12.7%
kv_lock_wait                   9.4%
other                         9.0%
```
sam: memcpy_v2 spike often indicates we hit the block-copy path instead of the zero-copy route. did the selector remap small batches to memcpy?
alex: yes — I lowered small_batch_threshold from 32 -> 16 to reduce kernel churn. that increased memcpy path usage for mid-size batches
nate: queuing traces show many short-lived batches now getting serialized, token/sec drops line up with increased memcpy time
ci-bot: starting automated bisect across merges 0d8..HEAD (targeting 0f4b3c9..e2a1d00 range)
maya: can we try toggling the selector flag in canary to confirm?
sam: try REDWOOD_KERNEL_SELECTOR=legacy for a quick test
maya: patched canary to legacy selector — tok/sec recovered to ~18k and p95 back to baseline within 2 minutes
rachel: confirmed on metrics: canary tok/s = 17.9k, kv_hitrate recovered to 91%
ci-bot: bisect finished: culprit identified -> commit 0f4b3c9 (kernel selector threshold change)
alex: I'm preparing an immediate revert PR for 0f4b3c9. also will add a safer threshold and explicit fallback path
nate: adding temporary routing rule: if kv_hitrate < 80% then route to legacy kernel path (circuit-breaker)
sam: adding regression test to perf CI that exercises memcpy vs zero-copy for seqlen/batch combos
rachel: will add dashboard alert: kv_hitrate < 85% OR tok/s drop > 20% triggers paging rule
infra-bot: rollout r-2026-03-18-13 paused by maya
alex: revert PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/pull/4823 (revert 0f4b3c9)
maya: plan: revert deployed to prod canary, monitor 30m, then roll to remainder if stable. follow-ups: stricter canary gating, add metric-based guardrails, update kernel selector test matrix. owners: @alex (kernel), @rachel (kv/metrics), @sam (CI/regressions)
sam: I'll land perf test and CI alerting changes today
ci-bot: revert PR CI started
ci-bot: revert PR CI passed
infra-bot: revert merged and rolled to canary
rachel: canary metrics look good — tok/sec and p95 restored
maya: thanks team. leaving rollout paused until we validate 1h of stable data, then continue. moving notes to #eng-runtime-ops for tracking
ci-bot: bisect summary: culprit commit 0f4b3c9 (kernel selector change), reason: changed small_batch_threshold -> increased memcpy path prevalence
maya: closing thread here. postmortem/follow-up doc in #eng-runtime-postmortems.
